milestone: Material-specific terrain detail maps and reduced environment saturation

detail_texture.sampling: Two scales of world-space triplanar projection; mipmapped and trilinearly filtered
detail_texture.shading: Material-weighted albedo, surface-gradient bump normals and roughness
detail_texture.materials: Shared-corner 65x65 mask; excavated triangles use rock detail independently of surface materials
detail_texture.comparison: Surface detail checkbox; shareable detail=0; toggles invalidate the cached reflection

changes.grading: Preserves linear luminance; reduces saturated environment colors more strongly. Applies to terrain, props, vegetation, water and environmental fog.
changes.visual_priority: Utility overlays, scout and UI retain signal colors. Cast-shadow strength and baked AO remain unchanged.

verified: Ground, cliff faces and prop colors at close range
Mixed biome overview with snow, ice and lava
Tunnel isolation with walls and ceilings
browser_review.performance_scope: Development-desktop UI observations; no mobile or sustained frame-rate benchmark.

limitations: Procedural detail maps approximate material relief; no extra geometric displacement or photogrammetry assets.
Biome placement and broad color transitions retain the existing generator behavior.
Snow and ice share a fine-crust detail channel; a separate ice optical material is not implemented.
Static environmental reflections exclude the moving scout.
